r: libStorageMgmt plug-in daemon. Plug-ins execute in their own process space for fault isolation and to accommodate different plug-in licensing requirements. Runs as an unprivileged user.

--plugindir
= The directory where the plugins are located
--socketdir
= The directory for IPC sockets
--confdir
= The directory where the config file are located
-v
= Verbose logging
-d
= New style daemon (systemd) non-forking
